Container.Name: Youtarr-Feed
Container.Overview: Mobile-first subscription feed for Youtarr. Browse channels, play local files, start or delete downloads through Youtarr, save single video links, sync watch progress server-side, and optionally sync watch state with Plex.
Container.Requires: A reachable Youtarr instance. A Youtarr username and password are required for the subscription feed unless you use a session token.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port where Youtarr Feed is reachable through your Unraid server.

Config.Name: Youtarr URL
Config.Description: Internal Youtarr address reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Youtarr Username
Config.Description: Youtarr username. Not needed when using a session token.

Config.Name: Youtarr Password
Config.Description: Youtarr password. Kept only as a protected server-side container setting on Unraid.

Config.Name: Youtarr API Key
Config.Description: Optional Youtarr API key for download commands. Feed access still needs login credentials, a session token, or disabled auth.

Config.Name: YouTube API Key
Config.Description: Optional fallback for exact YouTube publishedAt timestamps in Youtarr Feed. Prefer setting this key in Youtarr itself first; use this only if Youtarr still returns date-only values.

Config.Name: Youtarr Session Token
Config.Description: Alternative to username and password. Sessions can expire.

Config.Name: Youtarr Authentication Disabled
Config.Description: Set to true only if authentication is intentionally disabled in your Youtarr installation.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for server-side watch progress, Continue Watching, feed cache, and single videos.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal container location for persistent app data. Keep this set to /data.

Config.Name: Feed Cache TTL
Config.Description: Number of seconds feed and local-video overviews are cached server-side. Default is 300 for fast app starts without data staying stale for too long.

Config.Name: Youtarr Media Path
Config.Description: Same host folder as Youtarr's output/download folder. Mount read-only so Youtarr Feed can stream local files directly.

Config.Name: Media Directory
Config.Description: Internal container location of the Youtarr media mount. Keep this equal to the container path above.

Config.Name: Youtarr Source Media Directory
Config.Description: Internal media path as stored by Youtarr in its database. Keep this equal to Media Directory unless Youtarr uses a different container path for the same host folder.

Config.Name: VP9 Youtarr URL
Config.Description: Optional second Youtarr instance for VP9 playback. iPad and Mac Safari use this automatically when configured.

Config.Name: VP9 Youtarr Username
Config.Description: Optional username for the VP9 Youtarr instance. Leave empty to reuse the main Youtarr username.

Config.Name: VP9 Youtarr Password
Config.Description: Optional password for the VP9 Youtarr instance. Leave empty to reuse the main Youtarr password.

Config.Name: VP9 Youtarr API Key
Config.Description: Optional API key for the VP9 Youtarr instance.

Config.Name: VP9 Youtarr Session Token
Config.Description: Optional session token for the VP9 Youtarr instance. Leave empty to reuse the main Youtarr session token.

Config.Name: VP9 Youtarr Auth Disabled
Config.Description: Set to true only if authentication is intentionally disabled on the VP9 Youtarr instance.

Config.Name: VP9 Youtarr Media Path
Config.Description: Optional host folder for the VP9 Youtarr output/download folder. Mount read-only for direct VP9 local streaming.

Config.Name: VP9 Media Directory
Config.Description: Internal container location of the VP9 Youtarr media mount. Keep this equal to the VP9 Media Path container path.

Config.Name: VP9 Source Media Directory
Config.Description: Internal media path as stored by the VP9 Youtarr instance. Keep this equal to that Youtarr container's output path.

Config.Name: AV1 Youtarr URL
Config.Description: Optional explicit AV1 Youtarr instance. Usually not needed when the main Youtarr instance already owns AV1 or highest-quality playback.

Config.Name: AV1 Youtarr Username
Config.Description: Optional username for the AV1 Youtarr instance. Leave empty to reuse the main Youtarr username.

Config.Name: AV1 Youtarr Password
Config.Description: Optional password for the AV1 Youtarr instance. Leave empty to reuse the main Youtarr password.

Config.Name: AV1 Youtarr API Key
Config.Description: Optional API key for the AV1 Youtarr instance.

Config.Name: AV1 Youtarr Session Token
Config.Description: Optional session token for the AV1 Youtarr instance. Leave empty to reuse the main Youtarr session token.

Config.Name: AV1 Youtarr Auth Disabled
Config.Description: Set to true only if authentication is intentionally disabled on the AV1 Youtarr instance.

Config.Name: AV1 Youtarr Media Path
Config.Description: Optional host folder for the AV1 Youtarr output/download folder. Mount read-only for direct AV1 local streaming.

Config.Name: AV1 Media Directory
Config.Description: Internal container location of the AV1 Youtarr media mount. Keep this equal to the AV1 Media Path container path.

Config.Name: AV1 Source Media Directory
Config.Description: Internal media path as stored by the AV1 Youtarr instance. Keep this equal to that Youtarr container's output path.

Config.Name: Playback Profile
Config.Description: Playback routing. auto uses VP9 for iPad/Mac Safari when configured and otherwise uses the main Youtarr instance. Advanced values: primary, av1, vp9.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Optional. Internal Plex address for library scans and watch-state sync.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Optional Plex token. Used server-side only and never sent to your phone.

Config.Name: Plex Library ID
Config.Description: Optional numeric Plex library section ID for the Youtarr library.

Config.Name: Plex Watch Sync
Config.Description: Sync Youtarr Feed watch progress to Plex and import Plex progress when refreshing. Set to false if you only want Plex library scans.
